body: SCRUB LIST before the code goes public (replaces the note of 7 Nov 2026 21:05, which quoted the address): the Funnel address of the owner's test server is a name ending in `.ts.net`, which names his tailnet. Find every place with `grep -rl "\.ts\.net" docs` (and the same for any later test server). On 7 Nov 2026 that finds: two board notes under docs/roadmap/notes (P3-01 and P3-28), the audit file docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md, AND the first version of THIS note (docs/roadmap/notes/P5-06/20261107T210518Z-agent-2215.json), which quoted the grep. Notes are never edited: replace each with a note that leaves the address out, and decide with the owner whether the old files must also leave the history.
